data.text: Search quality is 0.75 recall@3 on the golden set. The three it misses are all the same shape: a question whose words are common in this corpus - labels, compaction, contract, promise - where a section that repeats one of them beats the section that answers. Field weighting past the heading, or expanding a query from the corpus own co-occurrence, is where the next point comes from. Neither needs a model.
